annualDividendDetails: Implemented pre-tax dividends for fiscal {year}: CNY {total} per share, including CNY {special} special dividend. Yield = total dividends / closing price CNY {price}; excluding special dividends: {regular}%. Historical, not a forecast.
portfolioDescription: Closing-price snapshots · Local holdings · Unrealized P&L
etfDescription: Compare ETF price performance and drawdown over a shared interval
localOnly: Holdings stored in this browser only
pnlNote: Market value = shares × snapshot close. Unrealized P&L = market value − cost. Excludes fees, dividends and realized P&L; this is not total account return.
importNote: Import the holdings Markdown dashboard or JSON exported here (up to 2 MB). Matching codes are replaced; other holdings are preserved. Files are parsed locally without upload. Export a backup before clearing browser data.
emptyHoldings: No local holdings yet. Add or import holdings to see valuation and P&L.
clearConfirm: Clear all holdings in this browser?
invalid: Check the file or inputs: codes must be unique six-digit A-share codes in the watchlist; quantity must be a positive integer and cost non-negative. Each value must be at most 10 billion.
storageError: Could not read or save local holdings. Check browser storage settings. Unsaved changes are not applied.
loadError: Could not load market snapshots. Please retry.
stockSource: A-share closes come from local daily archives; HK closes use the latest completed unadjusted Tencent daily candle, with date and HKD shown per row. Reference dividend yields and TTM P/E are Tencent snapshots collected at {updatedAt}, not necessarily closing-time metrics. Verified fiscal-year yields use implemented pre-tax dividends per share divided by the closing price; special dividends are labeled and calculations appear on hover. Other yields follow the provider and may include special dividends. Historical payouts do not guarantee future returns. Zero means a reported zero, missing values show a dash, and negative P/E is retained. Highs/lows use completed unadjusted daily candles within {rangeStart} to {rangeEnd}; shorter histories use available sessions, with actual coverage on hover. Holdings support CNY A-shares only. Static snapshots, not live quotes.
noOverlap: Fewer than two shared sessions. Change ETFs or the time range.
etfSource: Source: A_Shares_Datas / ETF, Eastmoney daily bars and Tencent fallback quotes. Unadjusted prices exclude dividend reinvestment and are not total returns. Only shared sessions with valid closes are used; all series start at 100. Drawdown is measured from preceding peaks within the selected interval. Periods look back from the snapshot end date, not live time. Fund names retain source labels.
orderNote: Move a stock to the top of the watchlist, or up/down within filtered results. Order is saved in this browser. Reordering clears column sorting.
orderReadError: Could not read saved order. Showing the default order.
orderSaveError: Could not save order. Check browser storage settings.
metricTime: Tencent quote time: {time}. Metrics use that quote, not the closing snapshot.
rangeDetails: Unadjusted daily prices: {start} to {end}, {days} trading days. Short histories use available trading days.
